'''BR-RR''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was around during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This unit was decorated and used during [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebrations, in particular resembling a snowman, with Life Day also being considered its favorite time of year because of this.

==Behind the scenes==
BR-RR is a droid Companion in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] that was released on December 30, 2011. When used on the battlefield, it grants its owner a Force Regen Up boost.
